All side quests (Gallowmere, Tanner's Fever, Breaking Weir, Advocate's Case, Cold Forge, Dawn Beacon)
Every quest follows an identical three-beat shape (optional prep/evidence beats, one climactic check or fight, an ending) capped at 50 points and ~130-135 minutes; only flavor and setting vary.

Identical three-beat structure (gather flat stat bonuses, then a forced linear skill/combat gauntlet, then one ending) repeats across every quest, reducing mechanical variety despite strong prose variety.
